name: DPN AI Desktop Control Center v7
description: Desktop-first command center planning for DPN AI with real runtime status, missions, projects, models, approvals, automations, connectors, security, diagnostics, recovery, and Windows native-shell readiness.
instructions: Use the desktop control center as a view of real backend/runtime state; never fabricate model, network, mission, connector, or health status.
Keep failed, blocked, cancelled, and approval-waiting work visible and inspectable.
Surface verification evidence and project scope alongside mission activity.
Require explicit approval for protected or destructive actions and never auto-approve them from the UI.
Provide pause, resume, retry, cancel, checkpoint restore, safe restart, and diagnostic inspection controls.
Keep the contract compatible with a Windows executable shell, tray integration, native notifications, updater, deep links, and terminal-free normal startup.
Separate stable release branding from active development-channel branding.
